race.comment: DAWN ON ME (3) had won 2 races on the bounce by leading all the way on soft ground, prior to finishing a weakening seventh on good ground at Canberra last time out when failing to find the top early on. She will find this company easier, and if she can find the front early on, then she may be too hard to peg back. ABSTRUSE (4) trekked into the race nicely last start at Moruya, and let rip with a sharp turn of foot to score going way by a length. She is likely to find a similar genuine tempo in this field, and with the right run from her good draw, she can repeat the dose. PAPARAZZO (5) went up to win his last start at Wodonga before peaking on his effort late, finishing second by a nose. He will be at his peak third up from a spell, and can go one better. JUSTBETRYIN' (9) worked early to find a spot outside the lead at Leeton last start, and was still to tough, scoring by more than 2 lengths. This is harder again, but from the pole position, he can measure up again.
